tests.title: A/B: one-click frozen TEST campaign and concurrent replay make one campaign, snapshot, reservation and send per recipient
C/L: mixed outcomes keep exact counts, hold unknown Tokens, refuse arbitrary resolution and reconcile provider proof once
L: unresolved provider status retains reservation and exclusion until confirmed NOT_SENT evidence permits one safe retry
D: pause stops new dispatch, resume continues frozen remaining recipients without duplicates
E: cancel before dispatch releases all; partial cancellation charges only confirmed sends
retry/pacing: only definitive temporary failures retry, attempts are bounded and never reserve twice
G/H/I: shared wallet never shares channels, campaign/message/delivery/attempt/audit IDs or control permissions
J/concurrency: insufficient/stale quotes and parallel campaigns cannot overspend the shared account
K/freeze: cooldown, do-not-contact and active reservations apply; frozen recipient/message survive directory changes
permissions/validation: editor/viewer cannot send/manage channels, invalid configuration never reserves, disconnected sender denies admission
database safety: terminal shortcuts, blind unknown retry, sender reassignment and changed operation settings are rejected
Dispatch authorization: recheck do-not-contact after freeze, honor provider rate-limit delay and reconcile an inactive channel without sending
Frozen set: no later recipient/intent can be appended to an admitted campaign
